integrity: All 13824 labeled three-voter profiles are exhausted. Dodgson and Young scores are each replayed by two independent exact implementations, and every divergent profile is canonicalized under all candidate and voter relabelings.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for four candidates with one or three voters under standard Dodgson and standard weak Young. The all-profile three-candidate equivalence is prior work; no larger-electorate formula is claimed.
title: Complete first Dodgson–Young divergence layer at four candidates and three voters
